title: v0.1.35 TUI Fixes: Selection Toggle & Dynamic Status Height
summary: Fixes mouse event cell motion text selection trapping via ctrl+y, clamps status bar height rendering, and prevents terminal window height miscalculations.

architectural_changes.what_changed: Added ToggleSelection keybinding (ctrl+y), added selectionMode state to appModel, and implemented ANSI escape code toggling to disable/enable mouse tracking.
architectural_changes.why: Restores native mouse text selection on demand.
architectural_changes.impact: Low risk, runtime key command toggle.

architectural_changes.what_changed: Clamped View() rendering output height to 1 row using Lipgloss MaxHeight(1) and MaxWidth(width).
architectural_changes.why: Eliminates duplicate status bar visual duplication.
architectural_changes.impact: Prevents status bar line wrapping overflow.

testing_and_verification.manual_testing: Verified ctrl+y toggles selection mode and status bar renders as a single row.
